task: Restore actual signed Digital Office draft autosave by removing illegal runtime object export from Next.js use-server action module

assuranceCeiling.rationale: User-visible signed Preview requests failed at the Next.js server-action boundary despite passing source CI. Critical integrity demands a minimal export-surface correction, full source regression and exact-head preview runtime proof before claiming draft persistence.

acceptanceCriteria: No non-async runtime export remains in src/app/admin/kommunikacio/iroda/composer-actions.ts.
Both new email and reply composers initialize their state from the same ordinary client module rather than the server-action module.
Existing composer autosave, manual save, revision conflict, owner denial and mailbox send-disable checks remain in place.
Full CI/TypeScript/build/Completion Truth and separately the actual deployment/runtime signed draft-save acceptance must pass before calling it a working user-facing feature.
invariants: Only exported functions from the 'use server' module are async Server Actions; exported TS types are erased.
Existing draft RPC admin_mutate_office_draft_v3 remains the sole revision-safe mutation entry.
Save is always possible without configured outbound mailbox; sending remains unavailable without a separate approved mailbox.
Author-private and tenant-bound draft view and owner explicit-deny semantics are unchanged.
forbiddenStates: Reclassifying the whole 'use server' module as a client module.
Hiding the Next runtime error instead of fixing its illegal runtime export.
Removing revision guard or enabling send without a mailbox.
Reporting the bug fixed in live preview without a new successful deployment and signed interactive save proof.

failureModes: The non-async officeComposerInitialState object remains exported from the server action file.
The new compose client imports state from the server file through a runtime re-export.
The reply composer still imports the removed initial state from server actions.
The shared initial state type diverges from the server action result shape.
The static regression only checks the initial state and misses a new future non-function export.
A crash disappears but autosave still hangs due to another runtime issue.
Authorization/tenant context changes inadvertently allow a support user to save another user's draft.
edgeCases: New email with one recipient plus subject/body autosaves and manual saves revision safely.
Reply draft path shares the same normal state initializer and Server Actions imports only functions.
No active mailbox continues to block Send while allowing a draft save.
Owner explicitly denies a support user and compose capability remains blocked.
A second browser revision conflict keeps fail-closed behavior.
Other named 'use server' modules are not rewritten as part of a one-feature fix.
A GET render that previously showed Server Functions cannot be called during initial render is separately observed after new deployment.
A missing Builder symbol table is not allowed to expand the Office fix beyond confirmed scope.

alternatives.summary: Move the shared initial-state object to an ordinary client-side module imported by both composers; keep only async Server Action exports.
alternatives.reason: Minimal and contract-compliant Next.js fix with no RPC/authorization change.

alternatives.summary: Duplicate initial states separately inside each client composer.
alternatives.reason: Introduces a small but unnecessary drift between new/reply form state definitions.

alternatives.summary: Remove the 'use server' directive entirely to silence Next.js export validation.
alternatives.reason: Breaks mandatory server action invocation boundary and risks leaking privileged database calls.

specialistReviews.resolution: Treat current text as unsaved; do not report saved until DB revision evidence and rerender on the new Preview.

proofPlan: Plan Before Code must pass on a fresh fix branch based on exact #1451 successful source head.
Change just four runtime source files and one existing composer tests file.
Run all unit tests, TypeScript, build, Completion Truth and lifecycle completion on exact code SHA.
Do not claim live fix until a separate protected Vercel preview of the patched branch completes and a signed user successfully saves/reads back a draft.
operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: A signed end-user on the READY Fresh Install Office preview cannot save email drafts because the Next.js 'use server' actions module includes a runtime object export; the runtime rejects every POST before the revision-safe RPC is reached. Earlier source CI passed 3575 static tests but failed to detect this Next.js runtime module contract.
observableOutcomes: Both new message and reply composer import their initial state from a non-server-action shared client module.
The Office composer-actions.ts use-server module exports only asynchronous server action functions at runtime, and its TypeScript state type remains usable.
Static regression explicitly enforces no runtime value exports from the Office use-server module; tested field snapshot/revision behavior and sending-disabled default are preserved.
unresolvedRisks: The Next.js preview must be rebuilt/deployed before the logged server-action failure can be considered fixed in a real signed browser.
Fresh may also lack Builder storefront_reusable_symbols; this is separate schema-contract drift and not a reason to skip the composer verification.
The runtime also logged Server Functions during initial render, which may be another independent code issue; must be re-evaluated post-deploy.
Mailbox count remains 0 and no outbound test may send a customer email.

in: Remove the illegal runtime object export from the 'use server' composer-actions module.
Place and import the initial state in the existing client-side autosave hook module; keep shared typed action state.
Add regressions that forbid non-async action exports and verify both composers call the same safe state object.
out: Do not alter DB RPCs, owner deny precedence, user/tenant authorization, mailbox provisioning or email sending.
Do not weaken the runtime preflight, production/staging target isolation, Fresh ledger or Pro feature gates.
Do not silently merge unrelated Builder missing-table fix or create a new runtime environment.

requirements.requirement: The signed Office composer uses a legal Next.js 'use server' async-function-only export module, enabling revision-safe draft writes without changing authorization or mailbox gates.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Never export runtime non-function objects from Office 'use server' module or authorize send without a mailbox.

notes: New isolated implementation transaction stacked on #1451 READY protected Fresh Install preview. Real 2026-10-20 Preview Vercel runtime errors repeatedly show Next.js 'A use server file can only export async functions, found object' during POST /admin/kommunikacio/iroda/uj, while composer-actions.ts illegally exports officeComposerInitialState (plain object). User typed a new email but autosave hangs/saving spinner and manual save disabled; no draft result verified. Also runtime reports missing storefront_reusable_symbols table and server functions initial render problem, separately tracked; do not combine Builder migrations with Office scope. This release unit addresses solely illegal action exports and regression proof. No Supabase hosted writes or Vercel deploy in this source change. The plan-only CI selected additional Template Factory Known Failure TF-KF-006 via admin/storefront UI applicability; corrected the guard digest fc1ef89c and canonical specialist role. No runtime implementation edits yet.
